title: BMUnun okutuuchuluk kurama spartakiadada baygeluu orundardy eeledi

blocks.text: 2025 年 6 月 23 日、6 月 30 日，吉尔吉斯斯坦疗养院“吉尔吉斯斯坦”疗养院阿拉辛达·塔克·尔根“Den sooluk - 2025”斯巴达基达西纳院士K. Karasaev atyndagy Bishkek mamlekettik Universityinen sporttun eki turunon ich kurama team katyshyp, bardyk komandalar iygilik menen kelishti。阿拉尔：45 zhashka cheyinker arasynda yushturulgan kichi Football boyuncha myrzalar arasynda okutuuchularybyz 3-奥伦杜， oshondoy ele 45 zashtan zhogorkular arasynda yushturulgan kichi 足球 boyuncha myrzalar arasynda okutuuchularybyz 3-奥伦杜, al emi 45 zhashka cheyinki kyz-kelinder arasynda yushturulgan 排球 oyunu boyuncha okutuuchularybyz 3-奥伦杜 kamsyzdashty。
K. Karasaev 院士在比什凯克大学的“Den Sooluk - 2025”中担任教授 duk-okutuuchuluk kuramga bekem den sooluk， issterine alban-alban iigilikterdi kaalaibyz。
